messages:
maya: Quick question — our team social on Friday has a low-key karaoke slot. Need one song rec that's easy to sing but fun. No lightsaber ballads pls 😂

alex: Omg go-to is 'Valerie' (Amy Winehouse) — crowdpleaser, range is forgiving. :thumbsup:

tess: If you want funny, 'I Will Survive' gets everyone. Also easy to fake the high notes. :laughing:

jamal: For low effort try 'Wonderwall' — eternal karaoke answer. also brings beers. :beer:

maya: Nice. Also saving a corner for book recs — someone said bring a memoir to swap? Looking for short-ish memoirs (300 pages or less).

nora: Highly recommend 'The Glass Castle' if you haven't read it — gripping and not too long.

alex: 'Educated' is great but a bit longer. For compact: 'Born a Crime' is hilarious + sharp, good airplane read.

tess: Ooh 'Etta and Otto and Russell and James' — not a memoir but similar quiet vibes. If strictly memoir, 'Me Talk Pretty One Day' is perfect and short.

maya: Nice list. Jamal — what karaoke are you gonna try?

jamal: Thinking of doing a surprise: start with 'Take On Me' (synthy panic), then switch to spoken-word storytelling about the chorus. Might be a disaster. :sweat_smile:

alex: Do it. If it's a disaster we'll film and it becomes team lore.

jukebox-bot: Added a quick playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXcF6B6QPhFDv?si=team-social-sample (mix: karaoke staples + mellow bops)

nora: Poll: karaoke vibe — 1) Classic singalongs (Wonderwall/Valerie), 2) Cheesy 80s (Take On Me), 3) Diva hour (I Will Survive), 4) Surprise experimental (jamal). React with :one: :two: :three: :four:

maya: Putting this in the event thread too. If anyone wants to swap books early DM me and I'll bring extras. :books:

alex: Also jamal, if you injure yourself I'll reimburse for medical karaoke therapy. :joy:
